newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan securities sector loses ground.
newsitem.headline: Japan securities sector loses ground.

text.p: Shares in the Japanese brokerage sector lost ground on Tuesday morning amid gloomy market sentiment and the prospect of liberalisation triggering fierce competition among securities firms, traders said.
The share price of Daiwa Securities Co Ltd was down 40 yen at 990 yen at 0128 GMT, after briefly slipping to 981 yen.
Nomura Securities Co Ltd shed 50 yen to stand at 1,640 yen, after dipping to 1,630 yen.
The sector was ranked at the top of percentage losers on the first section of the Tokyo Stock Exchange.
